description: A hanging bell has a domed crown, flared mouth and rounded clapper. A short hanger connects it to a horizontal arm on a tall post with a circular finial.
A single oval coffee bean tilts from lower left to upper right. A gently bending seam runs from end to end across its otherwise plain surface.
A pair of eyeglasses faces forward with two equally sized circular lenses. A short arched bridge joins their inner edges, with no visible temples or nose pads.
A bicycle appears in side view with two circular wheels and a triangular frame. A short saddle and an upright handlebar rise above the upper frame tube.
A birdhouse faces forward beneath a steep triangular roof whose eaves extend beyond the walls. A circular entrance and a short horizontal perch sit on the plain front.
A broad leaf has a pointed tip, rounded lower sides and a central stalk extending below its base. Paired diagonal veins branch from the straight midrib.
A flower with six rounded petals surrounds a circular center above a straight stalk. Two broad pointed leaves spread symmetrically from the stalk below the bloom.
A side view bicycle has two round wheels joined by a triangular frame. A narrow saddle and a slanted handlebar stem with a short horizontal grip rise above it.
Two large circular spectacle frames sit side by side at equal height. A shallow curved bridge joins the rims, while the rest of each lens remains empty.
A beaver sits facing right with a rounded back, small ear and projecting muzzle. Its bent forepaw rests forward, and a broad flat tail extends behind its seated body.
A bulging refuse bag has a broad rounded base and a narrow tied neck with an open flared top. Four separate wavy odor lines rise around it.
A rounded television rests on two short feet beneath angled aerials. Its inset screen carries two short horizontal eyes and a curved smile as an integrated cartoon face.
A toilet in side view has a tall rectangular cistern behind a long horizontal seat. Its curved bowl narrows into a pedestal with a wide flat foot.
A bear stands facing right with a long sloping back and a short projecting muzzle. Its plain body descends into broad legs, with the rear leg partly visible behind.
A circular sun with short rays sits above two rows of scalloped ocean waves. Three small angular birds are scattered across the open sky to the right.
Three empty horizontal rectangular bars form a vertical stack with generous gaps. Their left edges align, while the top bar is shorter than the two matching bars below.
A plain block of tofu appears in perspective with a broad sloping top and two visible sides. Slightly rounded lower corners soften the otherwise cuboid silhouette.
A palm tree rises from a low semicircular island on a curved slender trunk. Four broad pointed fronds spread outward from a single junction at its crown.
A bikini top and matching bottom are arranged vertically. The top has two rounded triangular cups and narrow shoulder straps, while the bottom curves inward toward a narrow crotch.
A curved path rises from a rounded square and bends toward a circular endpoint. A square node at its crest connects to a horizontal handle ending in another circle.
A winding stream curves between two trees with rounded lobed crowns and straight trunks. The broad foreground bank and tapering waterway create an asymmetric landscape viewed from above.
A bowed archery bow stretches diagonally across a taut angular string. A long arrow crosses the bow toward the upper right, with a triangular head and pointed fletching.
A lobed brain outline opens at the bottom into descending circuit traces. Three circular terminals sit inside the crown, each attached to a different bending vertical line.
A domed baby bonnet appears in side view with a broad curved opening band. A bow ties beneath the lower edge, and two loose ribbons descend from its knot.
A large car viewed from above sits toward the upper right, with a small window and side mirrors. Part of another car appears diagonally behind it at lower left.
A round bomb has a short angled neck and a curved fuse extending upward to the right. Short radiating strokes surround the fuse tip as a bright spark.
A tall hand drum has an oval playing surface above a tapered body. Wide bands encircle its top and base, while diagonal lacing forms large triangles around the shell.
A front facing dog head has tall pointed ears and a long broad muzzle. Curving facial markings meet between the eyes above a central nose line and smiling mouth.
A terrier head faces forward with oversized upright rounded ears and a broad forehead. Its narrowing cheeks end in a short divided muzzle with a small curved chin.
A tall bowling pin stands in front of a round ball at its lower right. Two horizontal neck bands mark the pin, and three finger holes mark the ball.
A boy faces forward in a shoulder length bust with rounded ears and a plain face. Side swept hair crosses his forehead above a narrow neck and curved shirt collar.
A circular outline contains a continuous wavy line crossing its middle from edge to edge. The upper and lower areas remain empty, giving the appearance of a liquid level.
A circular sun is centered between four detached straight rays pointing up, down, left and right. The equal rays and empty center form a balanced geometric symbol.
A tall flickering flame encloses a smaller flame at its base. Beneath it, two long logs cross diagonally to form an open support for the campfire.
A circular brake disc surrounds an inner hub and small center opening. A thick curved caliper covers the upper left edge, while small bolt marks surround the hub.
Six rounded square nodes form an irregular chain across three levels. Short horizontal and vertical connections link adjacent squares, with a longer line crossing the middle of the network.
A box shaped detonator carries a vertical plunger with a broad rounded handle. A cable exits its right side, rising in a loop before trailing down and outward.
A flower with four broad rounded petals surrounds a circular center on a straight stem. Two pointed leaves spread to either side below the bloom, meeting at the stalk.
A blimp has a long inflated oval body that tapers toward the right. Two tail fins project above and below its rear, and a small cabin hangs beneath.
A bow tie has two broad outward flaring wings joined by a compact rectangular knot. Rounded outer corners soften the matching sides, whose inner edges narrow toward the center.
A suit jacket faces forward with long sleeves and wide notched lapels descending toward its center. Two short pocket openings sit above the curved lower fronts of the jacket.
A raspberry consists of rounded overlapping fruit lobes tapering toward its lower tip. Three pointed leaves fan upward from the top, with the middle leaf standing tallest.
A boat faces forward with a wide curved hull and a raised central bow. A small trapezoidal cabin rises behind it while a rolling wave crosses beneath the hull.
A front facing person has a detached circular head above a broad rounded torso. Short arms hang at the sides, and a central vertical division separates two straight legs.
An upright hand shows a short thumb and four rounded fingers of varying heights. A narrow bracelet crosses the wrist, centered on a prominent circular ornament.
A pear shaped punching bag hangs from a short neck beneath a shallow overhead mount. Two curved seams divide its broad rounded body into tapering vertical panels.
A lobed brain protrudes above the horizontal opening of a head viewed from behind. Curving internal folds mark the brain, while the lower head narrows into a neck.
A rounded urinary bladder narrows into a long outlet at its base. Two curved tubes enter from the upper sides, extending upward beyond the pear shaped central organ.
A long smooth arc curves over the top and around the right side of an implied circle. Its separated ends leave a broad opening across the lower left portion.
A plain faced person wears a rounded bowler hat with a straight projecting brim. A broad shoulder length torso sits below the oval head, with a shallow curved neckline.
A human bust faces right with a rounded skull, small projecting nose and short flat chin. A long straight neck descends beside a single curved shoulder at the left.
A bed faces forward beneath a broad rounded rectangular headboard and smaller raised pillow. Its mattress projects toward the viewer above a deep front panel and two short legs.
A rounded square is divided into nine cells by two vertical and two horizontal lines. The evenly spaced dividers continue to the outside edge without gaps.
An open book has curved pages spreading from a central vertical spine. A raised page on the right overlaps another page behind it, creating a stepped outer edge.
An open cardboard box appears in perspective with four flaps spreading outward around its opening. Two tall side panels meet at a central vertical corner beneath the front flaps.
An outboard motor has a rounded rectangular engine cover and a short handle projecting left. A long lower shaft curves at its foot beside a broad two ended propeller.
A boat motor appears in profile with a large rounded engine cover and a small grip extending left. Its tapered lower housing ends beside a short shaft and curved propeller.
A small horizontal capsule shaped form sits inside a larger matching oval surround. Both outlines have straight middle sections and rounded ends, with a broad even gap between them.
A person kneels with one leg raised while holding a flared horn toward the upper left. The rounded head sits behind a bent arm that supports the narrow mouthpiece.
A person leans forward with one leg extended and both arms spread. A small ball appears beside the trailing hand, and a lone bowling pin stands to the right.
A slender dart extends horizontally toward the right, ending in a broad curved triangular point. Its long plain shaft has a small downward bend at the opposite end.
A long rectangular eraser tilts from lower left to upper right with gently rounded corners. A straight transverse seam divides the block into two distinct sections.

concept: Rounded Vertical Forms in a Row
description: Four tall narrow open topped forms stand side by side, each ending in a rounded bottom. Horizontal lines cross the forms at matching upper levels and partly matching lower levels.
A kitchen knife lies diagonally with a long narrow blade ending in a gently curved point. A short angled bolster separates it from a similarly slender rounded handle.
A tall dockside crane extends a horizontal arm above a boat with a small cabin. A hook hangs from the arm, poised over the boat's plain angular hull.
A short bolero jacket faces forward with rounded shoulders and long sleeves. Its open front curves inward on both sides, ending in short rounded panels above the sleeve cuffs.
A short sleeve blouse has a wide rounded neckline and a gently fitted waist. Its sides flare toward a shallow curved hem, while the sleeves end at sloping cuffs.
A horizontal capsule shaped lamp has a plain enclosed face. Three detached short rays extend to its right, one straight and two angled, showing light spreading from that end.
A hanging stocking has a broad rounded cuff above a short upright ankle. The foot swells outward to the left and curves smoothly beneath the heel.
A toothbrush lies diagonally with a narrow gently bent handle. Its broad rounded rectangular head carries three short parallel bristle marks across the upper end.
A cat sits front facing with pointed ears and a broad featureless head. Straight forelegs divide its rounded body, and a long tail rises beside its right flank.
A fish faces left with a broad oval body narrowing toward a forked tail. A single inward curving gill line marks the head behind its pointed snout.
A tulip has three rounded upright petals meeting in a cup above a straight stem. One long pointed leaf grows diagonally upward from the right side of the stalk.
A large circular bowling ball has two small circular finger holes near its upper right area. The holes sit diagonally apart within an otherwise plain round surface.
A round blueberry carries a prominent five pointed leafy crown across its top. A short central dash marks the crown, while the rest of the fruit remains plain.
A gaming die appears as a rounded cube with its top and two side faces visible. Sparse tiny pips sit on the faces, appearing faint within the broad empty panels.
A broad oval facial sheet mask contains two horizontal eye openings and one larger oval mouth opening. The three holes sit within a plain rounded face shaped perimeter.
A small shop faces forward beneath a wide sloping awning with scalloped hanging sections. Two tall front panels meet at the center inside a simple rectangular storefront.
A closed box faces forward with a broad rectangular front and rounded lower corners. A shallow sloping top narrows toward its back edge above a horizontal front seam.
A duck stands facing left with a rounded head, straight beak and long upright neck. A curved wing rests inside its broad body above two short feet.
A bird stands facing right with a pointed beak and a long diagonal tail. Its curved wing follows the back, while two slanted legs end in flat feet.
A broad curled outline resembles a right facing bird with a short beak and lower wing or tail. A detached pointed leaf shape floats above its right side.
A walking person strides to the right beside three vertical rows of paving marks. The figure has a round detached head, bent arms and two widely separated legs.
A tall boot faces left with a straight upright shaft and a broad rounded toe. Its curved sole steps upward into a distinct squared heel at the back.
A capped toothpaste tube stands beside an upright toothbrush. The tube narrows toward its broad lower cap, while three short horizontal bristles project left from the brush head.
A right pointing triangle sits at the open left side of a large circular arc. Its point projects toward the circle's interior, with clear gaps between the two outlines.
A many sided gaming die has an irregular polygonal perimeter filled with triangular facets. Diagonal edges converge at several internal corners, giving the unnumbered object a three dimensional form.
Two equal circles overlap horizontally to create a narrow lens shaped region at their center. Both complete outlines remain visible, and their centers sit at the same height.
Two rounded squares overlap diagonally, with the lower left square in front. The upper right square remains visible above and beside it, while the overlapping portion is hidden.
Two broad shouldered figures stand close together with the right figure in front. Horizontal bands cross their rounded heads, and two short horizontal marks cross the front torso.
A pair of briefs faces forward beneath a broad rounded waistband. Curved leg openings rise from the narrow lower center, defining a full rounded front panel.
A plain circular head floats above a broad shoulder shaped torso. The lower form has rounded upper corners, upright sides and a flat base, with no facial or clothing details.
A rubber boot faces left with a tall straight shaft and rounded toe. A separate sole band runs along the entire bottom, divided near the heel by a short line.
A whale faces left with a broad rounded head, small eye and curved mouth. A flipper hangs below, a forked tail rises behind, and two water arcs spread above its back.
A boar head faces right with an upright pointed ear and a long projecting snout. A curved lower mouth frames a sharp upward tusk beneath the rounded nose.
A window blind hangs beneath a wide rectangular top rail. Four horizontal divisions mark its lowered slats, and a long cord descends at the right to a round pull.
Three curved wind strokes sweep horizontally above and beside a large snowflake. The snowflake has six branching arms, while the wind lines curl back at their left ends.
A brassiere faces forward with two rounded cups joined by a short horizontal bridge. Narrow shoulder straps rise from the outer tops, and curved inner cup edges meet near the center.
A bullet points to the right with a long straight sided body and rounded pointed nose. A short open bracket shaped base sits separately behind its flat rear edge.
A bumper car sits on a broad rounded protective base. Its low curved front rises toward a recessed seat, with a tall backrest and vertical contact pole at the rear.
A long baguette leans diagonally behind a shorter rounded loaf inside a shallow basket. Short scoring marks cross both breads, and the basket has a broad curved bottom.
A beetle faces upward with a rounded head, two curved antennae and a broad oval body. A straight central seam divides its wing covers, with three jointed legs on each side.
